Goal: By 2037, the linear extent of disconnected migratory salmonid habitat will decrease from 197.96 km to 7.5 km within the Takla Nation WCRP geographic scope.
From 2027 to 2030, no new structures will be installed that act as barriers to migratory salmonids in the Takla Nation WCRP geographic scope.
By 2045, the linear extent of disconnected migratory salmonid habitat will not increase above 7.5 km within the Takla Nation WCRP geographic scope.
